Codye helps you present your code in more than 180 languages and more than 100 themes. You can export your highlighted code snippets to PNG, JPEG, HTML & RTF, while fine-tuning many options to your liking: 

- Show window buttons
- Enable Line numbers
- Custom or dynamic width of the code area
- Custom corner radius.
- Customize background color. Codye will look at your current theme and present you with custom colors to match the current style. You can also select any other color with the integrated HSB color picker. 
- Custom scale and resolution 
- Embed CSS styling to your HTML output
- Shortcuts integration for automating your snippets

Codye also allows navigating and using most of its features entirely from your keyboard, to enable power users to their most cutting edge needs.

Resolutioner is a simple utility app for calculating resolutions, aspect ratios, and saving resolutions for future reference.

The resolution calculator helps you to calculate a resolution by filling in the other side, according to your set ratio. Editing the set ratio is as simple as a tap, too. When choosing your scale, you can either put in a standard fraction like 16:9, or put in a resolution you want to scale up or down while keeping the same aspect.

And when you've got a resolution you want to save, just tap Add Preset to save it with a custom name. You can edit your presets at any time.

Resolutioner supports iPhone, iPad, and Mac. All of your saved presets sync over iCloud, too.
